defects: hf_antitone : Antitone f requires f to be antitone on all of ℝ, whereas gold only requires AntitoneOn f (Ici 0) — this is a strictly stronger (more restrictive) hypothesis than the gold statement
hf_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ f x requires nonnegativity on all of ℝ, whereas gold only requires nonnegativity on Ioi 0 — again strictly stronger than gold
hf_integrable uses IntegrableOn f (Set.Ici 0) instead of gold's IntegrableOn f (Ioi 0); mathematically inconsequential (differs by a single point) but not syntactically identical
